resources.string: With your consent, Restrainify reads which app is open, on-screen labels that identify feeds like Reels and Shorts, and the web address in supported browsers, to restrict the apps, feeds and sites you choose and enforce your limits. If you turn on the Visual filter, it also captures the screen to check it on your device. During a Burst lock it looks for uninstall and settings screens. It can show a restriction screen and return Home. Nothing it reads is saved or uploaded. You can turn this off in Android Settings.
